2607.08996.title: Model Agnostic Graph Prompt Learning for Crystal Property Prediction
2607.08996.paper_summary: Graph Neural Networks have emerged as a powerful tool for the fast and accurate prediction of various crystal properties. These models often encode domain-specific knowledge into their graph encoding modules, which increases their parameter size and makes their performance heavily dependent on domain expertise. Added to this, explicitly incorporating all chemical and structural features, that might influence a specific crystal property into the GNN encoder, is a challenging task. In this work, we propose a soft prompt learning framework that captures latent features essential for property prediction, which are not explicitly provided to the GNN. We introduce a novel multilevel graph prompt learning framework comprising both node-level and graph-level soft prompts. At the node level, we capture the local chemical semantics of different atom types, while at the graph level, we encode the global structural symmetry of the crystal graph. Our proposed prompt learning framework is lightweight and seamlessly integrates with any existing GNN encoder. Extensive experiments on popular benchmark datasets show that incorporating prompt learning significantly improves (3\% - 15\%) the performance of state-of-the-art GNN models in crystal property prediction tasks. Furthermore, the learned soft prompts enable cross-property knowledge transfer, enhancing prediction performance for properties with limited training data. Code is available at https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/Prompt.git
2607.08996.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡已成為快速且準確預測各種晶體性質的強大工具。這些模型通常將特定領域的知識編碼到其圖編碼模塊中，這增加了它們的參數大小，並使其性能在很大程度上依賴於領域專業知識。此外，將所有可能影響特定晶體性質的化學和結構特徵明確地納入GNN編碼器是一項具有挑戰性的任務。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個軟提示學習框架，捕捉對性質預測至關重要的潛在特徵，這些特徵並未明確提供給GNN。我們引入了一種新穎的多層次圖提示學習框架，包含節點級和圖級的軟提示。在節點級別，我們捕捉不同原子類型的局部化學語義，而在圖級別，我們編碼晶體圖的全局結構對稱性。我們提出的提示學習框架輕量且能無縫整合到任何現有的GNN編碼器中。在流行基準數據集上的大量實驗顯示，納入提示學習顯著提高了最先進的GNN模型在晶體性質預測任務中的性能（3\% - 15\%）。此外，學習到的軟提示使得跨性質知識轉移成為可能，增強了對訓練數據有限的性質的預測性能。代碼可在 https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/Prompt.git 獲得。
